decision_skill.name: recent_cycle_shape_with_amplitude_scaling
decision_skill.description: Forecast the next seasonal cycle by preserving the within-cycle shape of the latest complete cycle and scaling its amplitude using the recent change in cycle totals.
decision_skill.applicability: When observations exhibit a strong, stable seasonal cycle but the overall magnitude changes gradually between recent cycles.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Use the latest complete cycle as the shape template, estimate an amplitude multiplier from robust recent cycle-total ratios, and select this method only when rolling-origin validation shows lower absolute error than unscaled replay and seasonal aggregation alternatives.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when cycle phase or shape is unstable, recent totals are missing or near zero, scaling ratios are erratic, structural breaks are evident, or rolling-origin validation does not support scaled replay.
